description: This file contains unit tests for the TracingHelper class in the org.eclipse.hono.tracing package. It verifies logging behavior of error reporting using the OpenTracing Span interface, including logging errors with messages, singleton maps, and exceptions.

classes.name: TracingHelperTest
classes.description: Unit test class for TracingHelper, testing error logging functions that interact with OpenTracing spans.

methods.name: testLogErrorWithMessage
methods.description: Tests that logging an error message creates correct log items.

methods.description: Tests that logging an error with a singleton map creates correct log items.

methods.name: testLogErrorWithException
methods.description: Tests that logging an error with an exception creates correct log items.
